title: A Proof in Coq that Core Logic is not Paraconsistent
summary: Tennant claims that his Core logic $\mathbb{C}$ is paraconsistent. It means that the sequent of the First Lewis Paradox, i.e. $\lnot A, A \vdash B$ is declared false, and its corresponding antisequent, called `Claim~1', i.e. $\lnot A, A \nvdash B$ true, as in minimal logic $\mathbf{M}$. This paper proves that Claim~1 entails a contradiction in $\mathbb{C}$, so that, to preserve consistency, the Core logician must reject the claim that his system is paraconsistent.
